howItWorks.title:
WE WORK IN PHASES,
AT YOUR PACE.

steps.title: We study your needs
steps.description: A discovery session to understand your business, your current processes and your goals. No strings attached.

steps.title: Phase-by-phase quote
steps.description: You receive a detailed, transparent proposal broken into phases. You choose which ones to implement and when.

steps.title: We build and launch

steps.title: We stay by your side

service.title:
A TECHNICAL PARTNER,
NOT A VENDOR.

pillars.description: We analyse your business, processes and goals. We design a tailored solution — no generic templates.

pillars.title: Phase-based quote

pillars.title: Maintenance, backups & incidents
pillars.description: System monitored 24/7 with regular backups. When an incident happens, we resolve it. If the service goes down, we're the first to know and act.

pillars.title: Changes & growth

YOUR ENTIRE BUSINESS,
ALWAYS VISIBLE.

features.title: Alerts & incidents

items.name: Maria Rosselló
items.text: We needed a website that conveys trust and an automatic booking system. They built our site in three days and the AI agent answers patient questions 24/7. Now patients find us on Google and book directly.

items.name: Pere Fullana
items.text: I don't understand technology. I started with them on a simple landing page and now I have automated WhatsApp that manages my quotes. I'm thrilled because they handle everything and I don't worry about a thing.

items.name: Joana Aiguabella
items.text: We contracted the website and the agent to handle initial inquiries. Now clients find us easily and the agent qualifies leads before forwarding them to us. We've reduced missed calls by 80%.

whatsapp.title: Setup: WhatsApp Business
whatsapp.description: We will configure the WhatsApp Business API for your client. This service enables sending and receiving WhatsApp messages automatically from the portal.
whatsapp.prerequisites: You will need: WhatsApp Business API key, verified phone number, and Meta Developers Account ID.

step1.title: API Credentials
step1.description: Enter your WhatsApp Business API credentials.

step2.title: Webhook configuration
step2.description: Set up the webhook to receive messages automatically.

step3.title: Verification
step3.description: Test the connection to ensure everything is working correctly.

smtp.title: Setup: Corporate SMTP
smtp.description: We will configure the SMTP server for your client's corporate email. This service allows sending emails from any mail client.
smtp.prerequisites: You will need: SMTP server, port, username, and password from your mail provider.

step1.title: Server configuration
step1.description: Enter the SMTP server details.

step2.title: Verification
step2.description: Send a test email to ensure the server is working correctly.

landing.title: Setup: Landing Page
landing.description: We will create your client's landing page from a template. You will be able to select the design and customise the content.
landing.prerequisites: You will need: client content (texts, images, social networks, opening hours).

step1.title: Select template
step1.description: Choose the template that best fits the client's business.

step2.title: Fill in the content
step2.description: Customise each section with the client's information.

step3.title: Publish
step3.description: Review and publish the landing page.

landing_extra.description: Additional landing page for your client. The process is the same as a standard landing page.

agenda.title: Setup: Online Booking
agenda.description: We will configure an online booking system. Clients will be able to schedule appointments directly from a link.
agenda.prerequisites: You will need: Google Calendar or Calendly API Key.

step1.title: Calendar integration
step1.description: Connect the calendar where appointments will be created.

step2.title: Confirmation template
step2.description: Configure the confirmation message that will be sent to the client.

step3.title: Verification
step3.description: Test that the booking flow works correctly.

step2.title: Configuration
step2.description: Define the inactivity period and the message.

step2.title: Notifications
step2.description: Configure notifications for each stage change.

step2.description: Publish the gallery.
